description: A set of independent toggles with multiple values; for exclusive choice, use Segmented or RadioGroup.

howToUse: Use it to turn on several filters or formats that stay visible: bold, italic and underline; critical, warnings and info.
Each button shows whether it is on; the value is the list of options on.
Give the group a `label` that names the set ("Severity").
alternatives: Only one option at a time: Segmented or RadioGroup.

keyboard.action: Moves from one button to the next.
Turns the option in focus on or off.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback called when the value changes.
